2.content: Rate moves higher only if they reduce Manhattan distance to visible G while maintaining or increasing distance to nearest visible H, and a visible clear path exists around hazards to G; heavily penalize moves that decrease distance to any visible H even if they reduce dist(G), and prioritize ratings for safety detours that increase min dist(H) while progressing toward G, and boost ratings for moves maintaining multiple open directions away from H toward G; rate moves lower if they position the agent with fewer escape routes from visible hazards (e.g., moving into corners or narrow passages near H clusters).
